title: AM Best Upgrades Financial Strength Ratings for The Doctors Company
summary: AM Best has upgraded The Doctors Company’s financial strength rating (FSR) to A+ (Superior) from A (Excellent) and the long-term issuer credit rating (ICR) to “aa-” (Superior) from “a+” (Excellent). The outlook of these ratings is stable.
body_markdown:
**Napa, California—October 28, 2026—** AM Best has upgraded The Doctors Company’s financial strength rating (FSR) to A+ (Superior) from A (Excellent) and the long-term issuer credit rating (ICR) to “aa-” (Superior) from “a+” (Excellent). The outlook of these ratings is stable. The FSR of A+, long-term ICR of “aa-”, and stable outlook have been affirmed for The Doctors Company, an Interinsurance Exchange, and the following subsidiaries, which are part of The Doctors Company Insurance Group (TDC or TDC Group):


- The Doctors Company, An Interinsurance Exchange
- TDC National Assurance Company
- TDC Specialty Insurance Company
- TDC Special Risks Insurance Company
- The Doctors Company Risk Retention Group, a Reciprocal Exchange
- Hospitals Insurance Company, Inc.


The FSR of A+ is assigned only to select companies with superior ability to meet ongoing insurance obligations. The "aa-” ICR is assigned to entities that have a superior ability to meet their ongoing senior financial obligations. These ratings reflect The Doctors Company’s balance sheet strength, which AM Best assesses as strongest, as well as its adequate operating performance, favorable business profile, and appropriate enterprise risk management.


The acquisition of ProAssurance Corporation (PRA) has further solidified The Doctors Company’s strong market position. AM Best recognizes the company’s expanded scale and diversified portfolio, as well as its continued financial strength and stability.


“These ratings from AM Best reflect the solid financial position of our companies," said Marco Vanderlaan, Chief Financial Officer, The Doctors Company and TDC Group. "Our recent acquisition of ProAssurance allows us to help even more healthcare professionals meet the challenges of a constantly shifting landscape."


The FSR of the PRA subsidiaries rated by AM Best acquired in connection with the above-noted PRA transaction remain unchanged at A (Excellent) with a stable outlook.


**About The Doctors Company**
Founded and led by physicians, The Doctors Company ([thedoctors.com](https://www.thedoctors.com/) ) is relentlessly committed to advancing, protecting, and rewarding the practice of good medicine. The Doctors Company helps hospitals and practices of all sizes manage the complexities of today’s healthcare environment—with expert guidance, resources, and coverage—and is the only medical malpractice insurer with an advocacy program covering all 50 states and the federal level. The Doctors Company is part of TDC Group ([tdcg.com](https://www.tdcg.com/) ), the nation’s largest physician-owned provider of insurance and risk management solutions. TDC Group serves the full continuum of care, from individual clinicians to academic medical systems—more than 200,000 healthcare professionals and organizations nationwide—with direct written premium of over $2.5 billion and $12 billion in assets.
